email.subject1: a signal play for Clever Devices
email.body1:
Saundra, saw Clever Devices agree to the Hitachi Rail acquisition and win the SacRT real-time train rollout.

A deal of that size usually puts more transit agencies in play than the North America team can cover while the org integrates, and that's where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Clever Devices off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Saundra, quick follow-up for Clever Devices.

An acquisition raises growth expectations faster than headcount can follow. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your North America team needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Saundra, last bit of proof for Clever Devices.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer transit-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Saundra, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Working through an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a transit-tech motion? I'll tailor it to Clever Devices either way.
